title: Bring the mission-control site repository under Arcadia governance
purpose: Puts the mission-control site repository under the same Arcadia governance and agent tooling as the other repositories, so coding agents working there get the same briefs. It also adds a session-naming screenshot to the page that describes that feature.
serves: Serves the milestone of giving the mission-control site the same governed agent tooling as every other repository, which supports routing stated outcomes to the right Project.
done_when: A coding-agent session opened in the mission-control site repository can receive a dispatch brief, and the session-naming screenshot appears with a caption on its answer page on the staging site.

actions.title: Onboard the mission-control site repository as a Project
actions.why: The repository had no shared agent instructions or workspace, so agents working there could not get a dispatch brief.
actions.done_when: The repository is registered as a Project in the shared workspace, has paired agent instruction files, and a session there can run the next-action command and receive a brief.

actions.title: Add the session-naming screenshot to its answer page
actions.why: Shows the session-naming feature on the page that already explains it, so readers see what the text describes.
actions.done_when: The screenshot is committed to the repository and appears with descriptive alt text and a caption on its answer page on the staging site.
